_meta.purpose: Mock order service. Stands in for NovaMart's real order management API.
_meta.design: Returns FACTS ONLY. Never returns an eligibility verdict - policy lives in docs/, not in this file. Date arithmetic is done here so the model never has to do it.
_meta.anchoring: delivered_at dates are anchored to the reference date 2026-10-18 so the demo reads naturally. eval/run_eval.py freezes the clock with NOVAMART_AS_OF to keep the golden set reproducible.
_meta.pii: Deliberately contains no customer names, emails, addresses, or payment data. store_id + order_id only.
